description: Feasibility spikes for INA-fungal products (soil amendment, growth media, animal feed) that rely on natural spore transport for bioprecipitation

pivot_reconciliation_20260822.verdict: AMBIGUOUS status, resolved conservatively to 'blocked' rather than archived -- do not treat this as a recommendation to close. Entirely orthogonal to the §0.23/§0.24 architecture pivot; this note exists only because this track was in scope for the same reconciliation pass, not because the pivot affects it.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.evidence: spikes/README.md (dated 2026-08-02, i.e. written the same day, not stale) already records verdicts for all 5 core spikes: 001 dose-vs-background PARTIAL, 002 natural-transport-reach VALIDATED, 003 attribution-design PARTIAL, 004 strain-candidate-screen VALIDATED, 005 regulatory-classification VALIDATED, plus a track-level conclusion (the concept survives reframed as an agronomic product, dies as an event-scale cloud-seeding tool). Spike 006 (plantgeo-siting-engine) is explicitly NOT RUN and deferred.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.why_not_archived: The track's own plan.md step 5 requires: 'Report the verdict to the user; the user decides the next spike or track closure. Update this track's status in tracks.md and metadata.json together.' The README's own 'Recommended next step' section states three live options for the owner -- (a) close as complete, (b) run spike 006, (c) commission two follow-up desk items -- and none is marked chosen. No evidence in the repo shows the owner made this call. Archiving this as 'complete' would be a guess at an authorization only the owner can give; leaving it 'active' would misrepresent that all scheduled work is in fact done and waiting on a decision, not in progress. 'blocked' is the closest fit in the README's status vocabulary (cannot proceed without named evidence or authorization) and is the most honest of the available options.
pivot_reconciliation_20260822.recommendation: Surface the three-way decision to the owner directly; do not infer a choice.

dependency_mode: Standalone exploratory track. No dependency on historical tracks. The optional PlantGeo siting spike (006) may read public datasets but must not modify shared services, databases, or Railway resources.
activation_gate: Desk research and disposable computation only. This track does not authorize organism acquisition, field release, weather-modification or precipitation-efficacy claims, product commitments, or production mutations. Individual spikes execute only after explicit user selection.
